cohort: The study included 639,085 mother-child pairs linked through UK electronic medical records, with data collected between 2004 and 2021.
finding: Children born to mothers with an angioma were 64% more likely to develop IH, and children born to mothers with a PWS were nearly 20 times more likely to develop PWS.
followup_time: Children were followed from birth up to 2021, with a total of 4,270,773 person-years of follow up.
